# General Commands Requirements Quality Checklist: Initialization and Version Contract

**Purpose**: Assess completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage of General-command requirements, not implementation conformance.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Initialization safety, credential protection, preservation, version reporting, and command compatibility.
**Depth**: Standard
**Actor / Timing**: Peer reviewer before implementation.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required General entry points and their distinct local purposes explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003, Spec §FR-011–FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 Are all mandatory initialization components identified, including configuration, storage, installation identity, client access, and connection metadata? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements for data, configuration, and connection-file location selection complete for both defaults and explicit overrides? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Are credential confidentiality requirements defined for normal output, diagnostics, logs, and portable connection metadata, including secure-saving failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is “genuinely new installation” defined unambiguously in terms of prior identity and credential history rather than current access availability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are “usable client credentials” and “secure local credential saving” defined with objective readiness criteria rather than assumed from credential presence alone? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK007 Are complete, partial, and failed initialization outcomes distinguished by required component status, diagnostic information, and exit-status expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Is the preservation boundary explicit about user-owned values, credential status/history, active selection, and permitted bookkeeping changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are missing-resource completion requirements consistent with the prohibition on issuing replacement credentials for existing installations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–FR-006, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK010 Are local-only initialization requirements consistent across explicit context rejection, accepted no-op options, and documented default selection? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is successful version-output equivalence distinguished consistently from ordinary argument errors and existing option conflicts across the spec and planning documents? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Phase 1: Design / Version sequence]
- [x] CHK012 Are initialization-specific policy changes consistent with the requirement to preserve daemon, diagnostics, and explicit recovery contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013–FR-015, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Do first-use, repeat-run, and failure success criteria specify objective outcomes, comparison boundaries, and the fixture populations to which their percentages apply? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Is the version result specified precisely enough to assess equality, including version source, line content, trailing newline, output stream, and successful status? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Are feature-acceptance evidence requirements traceable to every acceptance scenario and every identified command overlap without equating requirements approval with implementation completion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are primary first-use requirements complete for a writable empty installation, explicit locations, and secure client-access setup without daemon or service startup? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK017 Are alternate setup requirements defined for missing configuration or metadata, customized local settings, and a different active connection? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are exception requirements defined separately for invalid configuration, inaccessible resources, unavailable secure credential facilities, and unusable existing access? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006–FR-009, Spec §User Stories 1–2]
- [x] CHK019 Are recovery requirements explicit about preserved completed work, non-rotation on retry, and the boundary between initialization and deliberate access recovery? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are concurrent-initialization requirements complete about at-most-one initial credential, preservation, conflict outcomes, and safe retry guidance? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are the concurrency requirements explicit about whether separate installations sharing an explicit configuration or connection-file location belong to the preservation guarantee? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a conflicting local installation identity, malformed existing metadata, corrupted or unsupported storage, and a data location that is a file? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009–FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are version-independence requirements complete for absent installation data, malformed local configuration, unavailable credential facilities, and a selected but unavailable remote Core? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-012, Spec §User Story 3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are latency targets quantified with applicable environment conditions and explicit exclusions, and is “supported local workstation” sufficiently defined for objective assessment? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK025 Are reliability requirements explicit about pre-upgrade backups, preservation after failed upgrades, and the difference between retained partial setup and rollback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-010, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Are diagnostic requirements specific about failed resources, created/reused/incomplete components, corrective guidance, and confidentiality without depending on vague “actionable” wording alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, Spec §SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Are secure credential-facility availability assumptions and the required failure outcome documented without implying a plaintext initialization fallback? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Are existing location defaults, supported storage upgrades, and explicit access recovery identified as dependencies with clear feature boundaries? [Dependency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Are independent-core, offline default-verification, and isolated-data requirements consistent with the project constitution and feature scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §II, §VIII, §XII]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK030 Is “identical results” scoped consistently so that version equivalence does not accidentally require identical handling of invalid argument combinations? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are missing optional identity or credential-reference fields in existing local metadata covered by clear requirements for preservation versus incomplete or conflicting access? [Ambiguity, Gap, Spec §FR-004–FR-006, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK032 Are the security boundaries for initialization and explicit recovery stated without implying that out-of-scope recovery behavior weakens initialization's no-secret-output requirement? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions]
